title: 철도물류산업의 육성 및 지원에 관한 법률 시행규칙 / queue:ARTICLE:4:0:00004:part:1/1
title_original: 철도물류산업의 육성 및 지원에 관한 법률 시행규칙
full_text:
Article 4 (Application for Financial Assistance)
(1) The application required to be submitted to the Minister of Land, Infrastructure and Transport under Article 7(2) of the Act must be in Form No. 2 as specified.
(2) Upon receiving the application as described in (1), the Minister of Land, Infrastructure and Transport shall verify the applicant's company registration certificate (if the applicant is a company) and business registration certificate through the common use of administrative information as stipulated in Article 36(1) of the Electronic Government Act. However, if the applicant does not consent to the verification of the business registration certificate, a copy thereof shall be attached.
